text: Claims are flowing in and getting routed automatically. Now Service leadership needs to actually see what's happening across both regions.
Devon builds a custom report type, then Warranty Claims by Region -- grouped by region and status, with an SLA-aging bucket field.
A supporting report and dashboard pull it together: claims by status, by region, and which ones have aged past the service target.
Marisol Fontaine, VP of Customer Service, reviews the dashboard -- as the role that sits above both regions, her numbers are the full picture.
The dashboard folder is shared with Marisol, Hannah, and Tobias, giving Service leadership one place to see the whole program.
